name: note_manage

variables.create_scope: ", scope" where notes have a scope, or empty
variables.scope: what `scope` means ("scope: \"project\" (default, when there is a project) or \"global\"."), or empty — the line goes
variables.records: other records a note is not for (", or the project's own records (tasks, decisions)"), or empty

description:
Write your notes: things worth keeping that are longer than a memory entry and not a skill — findings, a design worked out with the user, a list to come back to.

- create (title, body{{create_scope}}); edit (id, title and/or body — body replaces the whole text); delete (id).
- {{scope}}
- Not for facts that hold in every session (memory), procedures (skills){{records}}.
